national_news.title: Asian Para Games 2026 Begins in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan
bullets: The 5th edition of the Asian Para Games opened in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, bringing together around 3,000 athletes from 45 National Paralympic Committees competing in 18 sports.
Para-badminton player Pramod Bhagat and sprinter Simran Sharma served as flag-bearers for India's 281-member contingent, which includes 168 athletes competing across 11 disciplines.
India aims to build on its record-breaking performance from the 2023 Hangzhou edition, where the country achieved a best-ever tally of 111 medals (29 gold, 31 silver, and 51 bronze).

national_news.title: Kenya's Charles Matata Breaks Course Record at Vedanta Delhi Half Marathon
bullets: Kenya's Charles Matata won the men's elite race at the Vedanta Delhi Half Marathon with a record-breaking time of 58 minutes 52 seconds over the 21.097-km distance.
Ethiopia's Wudinesh Alemu won the women's elite title with a timing of 1 hour 6 minutes 35 seconds, leading the international women's category.
In the Indian elite division, Shailesh Kushwaha won the men's title (1 hour 5 minutes 5 seconds) while Ankita Dhyani claimed the women's title (1 hour 12 minutes 46 seconds).

national_news.title: India's Space Economy Projected to Reach USD 40-45 Billion in 7-8 Years
bullets: Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh announced that India's space economy is expected to grow from USD 9 billion to USD 40-45 billion in the next 7 to 8 years.
The announcement was made during a media roundtable on 'Space, Sovereignty and New Economy' organised by the Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi.
Key growth drivers include public-private partnerships, domestic and international investments, faster regulatory approvals, and sustainable business models.
